faces.name: The Unspeakable
faces.oracleText:
Flying, trample
Whenever The Unspeakable deals combat damage to a player, you may return target Arcane card from your graveyard to your hand.

faces.name: The Ur-Dragon
faces.oracleText:
Eminence — As long as The Ur-Dragon is in the command zone or on the battlefield, other Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Flying
Whenever one or more Dragons you control attack, draw that many cards, then you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.

faces.name: The Ur-Sphinx
faces.oracleText:
Eminence — As long as The Ur-Sphinx is in the command zone or on the battlefield, other Sphinx spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Flying
Whenever one or more Sphinxes you control attack, each player mills that many cards. For each player, you may cast a card that player milled this way without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: The Urza Finder
faces.oracleText:
Whenever The Urza Finder enters or attacks, choose a random Eternal-legal nonland card with the word "Urza" in its name. You may cast a copy of it without paying its mana cost. (Many Magic search engines have random card features. Some even have "random card from search" buttons.)
The Urza Finder gets +1/+1 for each different card name with "Urza" in it from among permanents you control. ("Urza's" counts.)
